rules.why: a Windows editor adds it; it is not a word

rules.rule: map Devanagari (U+0966..U+096F) and Arabic-Indic (U+06F0..U+06F9) digits to ASCII 0-9
rules.why: a human transcriber writes ५, a recogniser writes 5; they are the same utterance

rules.rule: canonicalise Devanagari nukta letters: precomposed U+0958..U+095F -> base + U+093C; ZWJ + U+093C -> U+093C; U+0929->U+0928, U+0931->U+0930, U+0934->U+0935; drop bare U+200C/U+200D
rules.why: za is one phoneme written three ways; the U+0929 family are spelling variants, not distinct sounds

rules.rule: delete Unicode punctuation, symbol and non-space separator characters (table in is_punct_or_symbol)
rules.why: the danda and the comma are sentence marks, not words

rules.rule: collapse every run of Unicode whitespace to one U+0020
delete U+0964 DEVANAGARI DANDA and U+0965 DOUBLE DANDA
rules.why: restated explicitly: the danda is the most common stray token in Hindi exports

rules.rule: lowercase every character outside the Devanagari block, but only when the lowercase mapping is a single character
rules.why: Devanagari has no case; single-character-only keeps U+0130 from expanding into two characters inside a token

rules.rule: split on U+0020 and drop empty tokens

does_not: no transliteration between Devanagari and Latin: kya and क्या stay different tokens
no stemming or lemmatisation: WER is lexical
no number-word folding: पाँच against 5 is a substitution plus a deletion, and that is a true statement about the two texts
no lower-casing of Devanagari, which has no case
identical rules on the reference and the hypothesis; there is no second code path

blend.why: A single accuracy number cannot answer "what should we fix first". ASR, diarization and timestamp error are three independent failures with three independent fixes, and any arithmetic that collapses them is a weighted average of guesses whose weights are always chosen after seeing the result. Read the three blocks separately.
